response.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(q.qualifyId) AS qualifying_count
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.location
), shares AS (
  SELECT city, qualifying_count,
         1.0 * qualifying_count / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT city, qualifying_count, share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
ORDER BY city;

assumptions.assumption: Cities are the distinct circuits.location values that have at least one qualifying record; circuits with no qualifying records are excluded from the share denominator and average.
